About the role
Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks - verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors - and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.
The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. We develop and execute strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform among our core audiences.

Our Consumer Product Marketing team helps people discover ChatGPT’s capabilities, build everyday habits, and get more value from our products and subscriptions. We bring together customer insight, positioning, and measurable adoption programs, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, Data Science, and Growth to connect what we launch with how people use it.

About the Role

As a Product Marketer on OpenAI’s Consumer Product Marketing team, you will help people discover what ChatGPT can do, put it to use, and keep coming back. You will own the consumer lifecycle email program, turning product launches and customer insights into campaigns that drive activation, engagement, retention, and paid adoption.

You will set the channel strategy and roadmap, develop compelling messaging and creative, and lead campaigns from brief through launch and measurement. Working with product marketing leads and partners across Product, Growth, Data Science, Engineering, and Creative, you will build relevant journeys for free and paid users, from their first experience with ChatGPT to discovering new capabilities and getting more from a subscription.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer who combines strong storytelling with analytical rigor and operational ownership. You should be equally comfortable sharpening a headline, defining an audience, interpreting an experiment, and improving how campaigns get built. Success means a repeatable program that delivers measurable user impact and useful learnings every week.

In this role, you will:

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and standards for ChatGPT’s consumer lifecycle email program across product launches, sustained adoption campaigns, and automated journeys.

- Turn product positioning, customer research, and usage insights into clear messages, compelling creative, and practical use cases that help people take action.

- Map the customer journey, identify barriers to adoption, and prioritize opportunities using audience needs, behavioral data, and expected business impact.

- Build and optimize onboarding, feature activation, setup reminders, and re-engagement programs that help free and paid users build lasting habits with ChatGPT.

- Partner with the consumer subscriptions PMM and Growth teams on trials, upgrades, and subscriber retention, translating plan value into relevant lifecycle campaigns.

- Lead campaign delivery from briefing and copywriting through creative development, localization, quality assurance, and launch, coordinating agencies and cross-functional partners.

- Define audience segments, eligibility, timing, and calls to action with Data Science and Engineering so each message reaches the right users at the right moment.

- Develop a testing roadmap across messaging, creative, targeting, and customer journeys. Partner with Data Science on experiment design and holdouts, then turn successful tests into ongoing programs.

- Measure incremental product adoption, active usage, retention, and paid conversion alongside email engagement. Share regular readouts with clear learnings, limitations, and recommended next steps.

- Improve campaign production and reporting through reusable templates, automation, and better tooling in partnership with Marketing Operations and Engineering.

- Partner with Growth and product teams to connect email with landing pages, in-product messaging, push notifications, and broader campaigns, sharing insights that improve the customer experience.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or growth marketing for consumer products, including hands-on ownership

title: Editorial Intern
description:
Job Title: Editorial Intern
Reports To: The Editorial Team Lead and the Managing Editor
The Editorial Intern contributes to ONC’s mission of providing nonpartisan news, opinions, and policy solutions by completing essential tasks for the Editorial Team at ONC. The Editorial Desk is one of the last sets of eyes on everything ONC produces, including but not limited to books, policy proposals, solutions, op-eds, and newsletters. Editorial Interns will be responsible for correcting grammatical and stylistic errors in ONC written content, as well as fact-checking this content to prevent errors and maintain accuracy. Editorial Interns collaborate with our Policy Content Writers as well as the rest of the organization. They will keep in constant communication with the editorial team lead and managing editor about the status of current projects and deadlines . This intern may have the opportunity to learn how to operate the backend of our website to review external writers' submissions and approve them.
A competency assessment will be given to candidates who are selected for interviews. This assessment will simply require interviewed candidates to edit an article to resolve grammatical and stylistic errors.
This position is remote, with work primarily conducted over Zoom and Slack, so applicants must be comfortable coordinating in a remote environment and are expected to maintain a high level of communication. Interns must commit to at least a full semester. However, many people choose to extend their internship past the amount of time they initially committed to, provided their performance meets the required standards.
Benefits: Flexible schedule, college credit, professional networking, and resume-building experience.
Compensation: This is not a paid position.
Responsibilities:

• Edit written content to maintain grammatical integrity for the ONC website and mobile app.

• Ensure ONC's commitment to nonpartisanship, ideological diversity, and civil debate is reflected in all published work.

• Participate in civil dialogue with conservative, progressive, and moderate writers.

• Work with script writers and core content writers to ensure consistency in all written materials.

• Fact-check written content to prevent errors and maintain accuracy.

The Editorial Intern should have the following skills, education, and experience:

• Current student working towards a degree in English or Literature, Political Science, Journalism, Communications, and/or related fields.

• Exceptional writing skills are required (English).

• Proficient verbal communication/speaking skills are a plus.

• High attention to detail.

• Prior editing experience preferred, specifically with AP style.

• Responsive, consistent, and effective communicator.

• Ability to work remotely and on their own schedule in order to make deadlines.

• Google Workspace experience preferred.

• Ability to attend Organization-Wide meetings every other week.

• Ability to attend weekly Editorial Team meetings.

• Must be authorized to intern in the U.S.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
OUR NATIONAL CONVERSATION (ONC) seeks to reduce partisanship and promote effective solutions to America’s challenges. Powered by America’s youth, we host a media outlet, produce educational materials and facilitate dialogue intended to make America a better country.

title: HubSpot Systems & Data Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Curvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales! We design and install complete sales systems from sales processes and GTM strategy to CRM setup all the way to fully outsourced sales engagements. Then we enhance those systems with AI enabled tools and battle tested playbooks, and finally, we provide highly trained sales talent to help our clients execute so their revenue engine runs faster, scales efficiently, and performs consistently. In short, we build and power modern, AI-driven sales systems that help companies grow with clarity and control.

POSITION OVERVIEW: HUBSPOT SYSTEMS & DATA ENGINEER

The HubSpot Systems & Data Engineer is the person who makes sure the infrastructure underneath our clients' sales operations actually works.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role centered around HubSpot architecture, data integrity, automation, integrations, reporting, and system performance. You’ll work across multiple client environments, identifying problems, building solutions, cleaning up messy systems, and creating infrastructure that can scale.

This is not a CRM admin role where you occasionally create a property or fix a contact record.

We’re looking for a legitimate HubSpot and data nerd who enjoys getting into the weeds. Someone who can look at a complicated CRM environment, understand what is happening under the hood, find what is broken, and build a better way.

This is an agency role. You’ll work across multiple clients, each with different sales processes, systems, data structures, and business requirements. Experience working in a client-services environment is critical.

Ideal background: HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar technology/implementation agency.

YOU SHOULD APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- You have agency, consultancy, or client-services experience

- You’ve preferably worked for a HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar organization

- You have configured and optimized HubSpot environments for multiple clients

- HubSpot is basically your playground

- You understand CRM architecture, objects, properties, pipelines, workflows, automation, and data structures

- You’ve worked with integrations, APIs, webhooks, dialers, schedulers, reporting tools, or other sales technology

- You’re obsessive about clean, accurate, usable data

- You enjoy troubleshooting why data isn't behaving the way it should

- You can walk into a messy HubSpot account and quickly identify what needs to change

- You understand how CRM data impacts reporting, attribution, forecasting, and sales execution

- You’re comfortable managing multiple client environments simultaneously

- You’d rather fix the root cause than keep patching the same problem every week

- You enjoy documenting systems so other people can actually understand and maintain them

YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- Your HubSpot experience has primarily been as an end user

- You’ve only managed a single internal CRM environment

- You have no agency, consulting, or client-services experience

- You don't enjoy working across multiple client environments

- "Data hygiene" sounds painfully boring to you

- You prefer strategy without getting into the technical weeds

- You aren't comfortable troubleshooting integrations and system issues

- You don't care whether the underlying data is accurate as long as the dashboard looks good

- You need someone else to tell you exactly what to build

CORE OUTCOMES

- HubSpot environments are clean, scalable, and intentionally structured

- CRM data is accurate, reliable, and usable

- Workflows, automations, and integrations operate as intended

- Data issues are identified and resolved before they become operational problems

Role Title: Game Designer / Gameplay Developer (AI Video Annotation)
Role Type: Contractor, Remote
Location: North America, Latin America, Europe, UK, and Oceania
micro1 is engaging Game Designers and Gameplay Developers for a project focused on reviewing and annotating video sessions of robotic arms completing real-world tasks. This is an AI training and data annotation project rather than a traditional game development assignment.
Your experience breaking complex activity into actions, states, interactions, and outcomes is highly relevant to this work. • Identify and label actions, object interactions, state changes, task outcomes, errors, and other relevant events within each video segment.

• Apply your understanding of action sequences, system states, cause and effect, and success or failure conditions to interpret robotic behavior accurately.

• Use dedicated annotation tools to tag video content precisely and consistently.

• Flag unclear or ambiguous moments and explain your reasoning in concise written notes.

• Contribute to quality control by reviewing annotations and providing constructive feedback when requested.

• Complete assigned batches accurately and within established deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional or academic background in game design, gameplay development, technical game design, game QA, or a related field.

• Strong understanding of action sequences, object states, interactions, rules, and cause-and-effect relationships.

• Experience reviewing, testing, debugging, or documenting gameplay behavior.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply the same criteria consistently across repetitive visual tasks.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain observations and edge cases clearly.

• Experience with data annotation, visual QA, AI training projects, or robotics is helpful but not required.
